## History

Fifty years prior, Aaron brought two china dogs from [London](../codex/places.md#london) to sit by the fireplace. [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue) was later named in his honor. Upon his death, Aaron left Patty's Place to his sister in his will.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032)_
